outcome: Fraction of exhaled nitric oxide (FeNO) levels
cohort: The study investigated two birth cohorts, COPSAC2000 (411 children) and COPSAC2010 (700 children), with FeNO measurements taken from age 5-18 years in the first and 5-10 years in the second.
finding: FeNO is elevated through childhood in children with asthma and correlates with asthma-associated traits, but only among children with concurrent aeroallergen sensitization, indicating it is a valid asthma biomarker only in this subgroup.
